scope: Commit-24 required devices key and golden-section progress expression

task_diff: convert_model.main adds devices to its quant_args dictionary
ldlq, g_scale_gss and quantize_tiles_multigpu read quant_args["devices"] without a default

repository_caller.construction: quant_args contains K and seed only, then linear.convert_exl3 is called

required_devices_key.result_by_source: The repository test path reaches an unconditional quant_args["devices"] read and therefore raises KeyError before quantization can proceed.
required_devices_key.reach: convert_model.main supplies the key. The repository test does not. The whole-tree review found no other repository builder of quant_args for Linear.convert_exl3; external callers remain possible.

scale_progress.source_rule: After each golden-section contraction, 0 <= delta2 / delta1 < 1, so int(delta2 / delta1) is 0 and the update value is 100 while the loop continues.
scale_progress.scalar_transcription: The commit-24 authoring run modeled the interval contraction from width 1.8 to below 0.01; all eleven updates were 100 and the final width was approximately 0.009045.
scale_progress.reach: Progress display only; the search objective and interval updates do not depend on the reported progress value.

limits: No repository test, CUDA code or conversion was executed for the missing-key observation.
The progress computation used standard-library scalar arithmetic only.
External callers and terminal rendering were not assessed.
